questions.query: Why does native Brine inertial cellular require radius three when it only travels two cells per tick?
facts: Travel writes reach two; final support and contact-side reads can reach three.
IN requires explicit radius3 and matched comparison geometry; current default preset remains radius2.

questions.query: Does the six byte Brine IN sidecar allocate only for Brine cells, and which hash capture and memory costs are qualified?
facts: Dense optional arrays cover every resident chunk when World policy enables IN.
IN uses explicit hash3/CYPS3; existing non-IN formats retain their field emission.
Reported component sum excludes allocator metadata/shared resources/RSS; native-only proof does not qualify Godot or runtime publication.
